title: Insurance Policy Application
description: Insurance Policy Application contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-insurance-insurance-policy-application
  title: Insurance Policy Application
  description: Insurance Policy Application contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
  version: insurance_insurance_policy_application_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: insurance/insurance_policy_application
    sourcePath: Schemas/insurance/insurance_policy_application
    sourceVersion: insurance_insurance_policy_application_v1
    sourceDigest: e74d681da10a8e1d5930be8f200d8858b8ebdd529da886c450a2679cb5571d3f
spec:
  role: start
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Insurance Policy Application
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: application-date
              name: application_date
              label: Application Date
              description: Date the application was completed or submitted.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
            - id: effective-date-requested
              name: effective_date_requested
              label: Effective Date Requested
              description: Requested policy effective date.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: applicant-entity-type
              name: applicant_entity_type
              label: Applicant Entity Type
              description: Individual, corporation, LLC, trust, or other legal form.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: deductible-requested
              name: deductible_requested
              label: Deductible Requested
              description: Requested deductible or retention.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: loss-history-summary
              name: loss_history_summary
              label: Loss History Summary
              description: Applicant's stated loss or claims history.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: annual-revenue
              name: annual_revenue
              label: Annual Revenue
              description: Annual revenue when commercial exposure is stated.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: employee-count
              name: employee_count
              label: Employee Count
              description: Employee count when applicable.
              dataType: integer
              widget: number
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: applicant-name
              name: applicant_name
              label: Applicant Name
              description: Named applicant or proposed insured.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: insured-property-or-risk
              name: insured_property_or_risk
              label: Insured Property Or Risk
              description: Property, operation, person, or risk to be insured.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: prior-carrier-names
              name: prior_carrier_names
              label: Prior Carrier Names
              description: Prior insurance carriers when listed.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: producer-name
              name: producer_name
              label: Producer Name
              description: Agent, broker, or producer name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: property-or-asset
          title: Property Or Asset
          description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: mailing-address
              name: mailing_address
              label: Mailing Address
              description: Applicant mailing address.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: policy-type-requested
              name: policy_type_requested
              label: Policy Type Requested
              description: Line of business or coverage type requested.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: coverage-limit-requested
              name: coverage_limit_requested
              label: Coverage Limit Requested
              description: Requested coverage limit or policy amount.
              dataType: number
              widget: number
            - id: risk-controls
              name: risk_controls
              label: Risk Controls
              description: Safety, security, compliance, or loss control measures.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              span: 2
            - id: underwriting-status
              name: underwriting_status
              label: Underwriting Status
              description: Submitted, quoted, bound, declined, pending, or other status.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: applicant-name-present
      severity: error
      description: applicant_name is required for Insurance Policy Application extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: applicant_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: applicant_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: applicant_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(applicant_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: policy-type-requested-present
      severity: error
      description: policy_type_requested is required for Insurance Policy Application extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: policy_type_requested
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: policy_type_requested
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: policy_type_requested IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(policy_type_requested)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: effective-date-requested-present
      severity: error
      description: effective_date_requested is required for Insurance Policy Application extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: effective_date_requested
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: effective_date_requested
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: effective_date_requested IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(effective_date_requested)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: coverage-limit-requested-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: coverage_limit_requested should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: coverage_limit_requested
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: coverage_limit_requested
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: coverage_limit_requested IS NULL OR coverage_limit_requested >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: deductible-requested-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: deductible_requested should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: deductible_requested
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: deductible_requested
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: deductible_requested IS NULL OR deductible_requested >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: annual-revenue-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: annual_revenue should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: annual_revenue
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: annual_revenue
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: annual_revenue IS NULL OR annual_revenue >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      applicant_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Insurance Policy Application workflow.
      policy_type_requested:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Insurance Policy Application workflow.
      coverage_limit_requested:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Insurance Policy Application workflow.
      underwriting_status:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Insurance Policy Application workflow.
      effective_date_requested:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Insurance policy application extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Insurance Policy Application documents mix policy, coverage, claim, party, financial, and
      regulatory notice context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      application_date:
        type: date
        description: Date the application was completed or submitted.
        format: date
      applicant_name:
        type: string
        description: Named applicant or proposed insured.
      applicant_entity_type:
        type: string
        description: Individual, corporation, LLC, trust, or other legal form.
      mailing_address:
        type: string
        description: Applicant mailing address.
      policy_type_requested:
        type: string
        description: Line of business or coverage type requested.
      effective_date_requested:
        type: date
        description: Requested policy effective date.
        format: date
      coverage_limit_requested:
        type: number
        description: Requested coverage limit or policy amount.
      deductible_requested:
        type: number
        description: Requested deductible or retention.
      insured_property_or_risk:
        type: string
        description: Property, operation, person, or risk to be insured.
      prior_carrier_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Prior insurance carriers when listed.
      loss_history_summary:
        type: string
        description: Applicant's stated loss or claims history.
      annual_revenue:
        type: number
        description: Annual revenue when commercial exposure is stated.
      employee_count:
        type: integer
        description: Employee count when applicable.
      risk_controls:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Safety, security, compliance, or loss control measures.
      producer_name:
        type: string
        description: Agent, broker, or producer name.
      underwriting_status:
        type: string
        description: Submitted, quoted, bound, declined, pending, or other status.
    required:
      - applicant_name
      - policy_type_requested
      - effective_date_requested
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - applicant_name
            - policy_type_requested
            - effective_date_requested
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - parties
            - property_or_asset
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
